lines.en: I give Niki a call to see if she wants to go out for breakfast but, being tired of the sausage fest (Which I didn't realize was possible), she decides to come over to my neighborhood instead.
lines.zh: 我给 Niki 打了个电话，问她要不要出去吃早餐，可她大概是腻透了满眼香肠的场面（我真没想到这也有腻的一天），于是决定改来我住的这一带。

lines.en: Of course, she refuses to part with her disguise as the two of us walk around in public.
lines.zh: 当然，我们俩在公共场合走动时，她死活不肯摘掉那身伪装。

lines.en: But, honestly, I’m surprised that disguise does {i}anything{/i} at all considering there aren’t many young, pink-haired bombshells just casually wandering the streets of Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 不过说实话，我还挺惊讶那套伪装{i}居然能起作用{/i}——毕竟在 Kumon-mi 的街上随随便便晃荡的年轻粉发尤物可没几个。

lines.en: I make sure to notify her of this, which she does not appreciate at all and, in typical tsundere fashion, she proceeds to berate me for the next thirty minutes over it.
lines.zh: 我特意把这一点告诉了她，她对此一点也不领情，还按经典的傲娇套路，就这件事数落了我整整三十分钟。

lines.en: It’s fine, though. It’s not like I wanted her praise anyway.
lines.zh: 不过没关系。反正我也没指望她夸我。

lines.en: The two of us continue to walk around the area for about half an hour or so and Niki’s beratement turns into a lengthy comparison of my current neighborhood to the one we grew up in.
lines.zh: 我们俩又在这一带走逛了大概半个小时，Niki 的数落渐渐变成了把我现在的街区和我们长大的那个街区做长篇对比。

lines.en: Having no recollection of such a thing, I listen closer than I typically would and come to find that, in one way or another, things have improved a lot for me.
lines.zh: 我对那种事毫无记忆，于是听得比平时更仔细，这才慢慢发现，不管怎么看，我的处境都已经好了很多。

lines.en: I’m not sure if I’d call being periodically subjected to the apocalypse an improvement in {i}every{/i} regard, but it’s still nice to hear that things somehow worked out well for the two of us.
lines.zh: 我不确定“时不时被卷进世界末日”能不能算{i}全方位{/i}的改善，但听到我们俩最后总算是熬出头了，我还是挺高兴的。

lines.en: Sure, I might not be a famous idol or anything like that-
lines.zh: 没错，我可能不是什么知名偶像之类的——

lines.en: But I get to have sex with as many attractive teenagers as I want. Which, by my standards, is a hell of a lot better.
lines.zh: 但我想和多少漂亮的高中生上床就能和多少上床。按我的标准，这可强太多了。
